messages:
maria: Heads-up — the curl example under /runtime/getting-started returns 403 on staging when run without the -H 'Host: runtime.staging.redwood' header. Repro steps below.

maria: ```bash
curl -i https://staging.redwood-inference.com/runtime/quickstart -s
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
...
```

devon: Ack, thanks. Which doc path? I'll take a look.

maria: docs/runtime/quickstart.md line ~42 (snippet block labeled 'curl-example'). Probably old staging host.

devon: I can open a quick PR to swap host to runtime.staging.redwood-inference.com and add note about host header.

sam: @devon if it's just a host replace + short note I can review fast. ping me when draft PR up.

nora: FYI this snippet is used in onboarding flow; small change affects tutorial outputs. Can we add both forms and a brief note? :thinking:

devon: good call, will add both: direct curl + curl with Host header. Drafting now — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1423

maria: Nice. Also can we update snippet to use --fail to make errors obvious? e.g., `curl --fail -sS`

devon: Yup. I'll include that and a one-liner sed for maintainers: `git grep -l "staging.redwood-inference.com" | xargs sed -i '' 's/staging.redwood-inference.com/runtime.staging.redwood-inference.com/g'`

sam: small nit — on macOS sed -i needs backup arg; maybe show `sed -i.bak` or use perl. but fine for PR.

docs-bot: New PR opened by devon: #1423 — docs/runtime/quickstart.md update (curl snippet) :robot_face:

nora: Assign reviewers @sam @maria. @sam please focus on correctness, @maria on onboarding wording.

sam: Assigned. I'll take a look in the morning. :eyes:

devon: Thx all — putting it in small-change queue. ETA EOD PST.

maria: Thanks! leaving a quick test path: run `curl --fail -sS https://staging.redwood-inference.com/runtime/quickstart` then `curl --fail -sS -H "Host: runtime.staging.redwood-inference.com" https://staging.redwood-inference.com/runtime/quickstart` to confirm both.

nora: Also can we add an editors note in the doc frontmatter: `doc_owner: platform-docs-team`? who owns that frontmatter?

devon: I don't have rights to frontmatter ownership. @maria can you add `doc_owner` or point to who does?

maria: I can add; my team handles onboarding docs. I'll add the field in PR and update CODEOWNERS referral.

sam: LGTM. small review pending.

devon: PR merged 1769997845 by devon — patch: curl example + host note + frontmatter owner. :white_check_mark:

maria: Verified on staging, both curl forms return 200. Thanks y'all. :tada:

sam: Thanks! Closing thread.
